## Verdict

wrong

## Bearer

RaceRepository / RaceRepositoryImpl — core-data/src/main/kotlin/com/mgilli/core/data/race/RaceRepositoryImpl.kt

## Trigger

saveImportedRace and saveRecordedRace, already called by
ImportPreviewViewModel.onSaveClicked (app-phone/.../ui/importpreview/ImportPreviewViewModel.kt)
and RecordedRaceListenerService.onMessageReceived
(app-phone/.../sync/RecordedRaceListenerService.kt) — observed

## Today

RaceRepositoryImpl.rename trims the incoming name and fails with
IllegalArgumentException when the trimmed value is empty or longer
than MAX_NAME_LENGTH (40). saveImportedRace and saveRecordedRace
build their Race with the name argument as received — no trim, no
length check, no rejection — so an imported race (name typed on the
paste screen) or a recorded race (name carried in the watch's sync
payload) can be stored with a name renaming it would refuse.

Separately, PasteResultViewModel.isImportEnabled computes
`pastedText.isNotEmpty() && raceName.isNotEmpty()`: a raceName made
only of spaces is non-empty, so the "Importer" action is enabled and
the name reaches ImportPreviewViewModel.onSaveClicked, then
saveImportedRace, without ever being trimmed or rejected.

## Expected

saveImportedRace and saveRecordedRace apply the same rule rename
applies: the name is trimmed, and the call fails — the race is not
persisted — when the trimmed value is empty or exceeds 40 characters,
exactly as rename does today.

PasteResultViewModel.isImportEnabled tests `raceName.isNotBlank()`
instead of `raceName.isNotEmpty()`, so a name made only of spaces
does not enable the "Importer" action.

ImportPreviewViewModel.onSaveClicked, which today only reacts to
saveImportedRace's success (`.onSuccess { ... }`), also reacts to a
failure: once saveImportedRace can reject a name (too long, or
blank after the paste screen's own check is bypassed by editing after
enabling), a rejected save must not silently do nothing on the
"Enregistrer" action — it needs a path back to the user, since none
exists today.
